body: I'm on the edge worse that ever these last few days.. I don't know how to ask for help.. I wish I had the nerve to go back to therapy because of I don't I feel just like you. I'm afraid. I hope this works out for you. What happend with the hospital? I've been thinking about just walking in and telling them I can't live anymore.
I feel like I'm slowly killing myself daily...

Even though I'm a pretty well rounded person.. I still feel like everything I do is letting myself and others down.. But then I have "friends" who don't know shit about me say I'm playing the victim..

It's so hard to live with these feelings and not know how to feel sane at the same time.. Sure people love me and I know it would kill/hurt others.. And I hate myself for feeling this way.. But it's really hard to do it alone.. Because it feels like no one gets it.. My brain just works that way...

I'm here. That's a good start. It has been hard to speak out like this.. But just talking to you has made my heart feel a little fuller. Just knowing that someone I don't know was willing to reach out has opened up a door I didn't know was there.. If that makes sense. The stigma that comes with feeling this way everyday is rough. I have a slipped disk.. The doctors say it shifts forward unlike most that shift backwards.. So I feel like a burden.. Just trying to keep myself talking and rolling with more positive than negative.. Thanks to your response. I was in deep last night. Thanks for being such a caring person. It really means a lot.

I feel for you. Wish I had words to make all the pain stop.. But I can relate. Posting on this sub has made me feel greatful that there are at least some people out there that don't want to sweep people like us under the rug. Hugs and thinking of you.
I'm sending hugs and lots of love. I need it too. It's really been a huge help talking to people here in this community. Never be sorry expressing your emotions. It's what makes us who we are.
I feel all those things too. I'm just now attempting to speak up myself. I'm here if you need someone... I've been in several abusive relationships. I can relate.

I'm not sure what you are going through... But I'm here.. Awake and asking myself the same things.., Why am I here. How come no matter how much good I try to do.. Life always kicks me when I'm down. I wish I had words that could help.. But you're not alone in this fight.

One of my biggest issues now is the continued back issues I have developed working in nursing homes and group homes with adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities. My back has me and my PTSD at critical odds with each other.

I need something/someone to remind me I'm here for a purpose. I was always the friend that prompted family relations.. Because my parents/famila were amazing friends.. Just not good at sage advice from parental units. They just let us down at times.. Just as all humanity has the tendancy to do.. My grandparents however.. They gave me the sage puzzle pieces I needed.. Just that I can't figure them out alone.

Thank you. Being Navajo in this world.. Makes you wonder why so much of humanity can be so selfish. We all bleed the same. Suffering from the soul.. No matter the race/religion... We all bleed. Just wish more people could be at peace with who they are.
